prices.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview (claude-opus-5-5: $4 input, $20 output, $0.20 cache read per million tokens; 5m cache write $5, 1h cache write $8)

data_retention_note: claude-opus-5-5 is not documented as a Covered Model (claude-fable-5-1's mandatory 30-day retention requirement does not carry over); the operator's organization is not zero-data-retention, so Anthropic's standard API retention applies to request data (up to 30-day retention). Lab camera images and depth data sent with every call leave this machine.
model_verified: 2026-10-02: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview lists claude-opus-5-5 (released 2026-09-22, status Active (latest), 1M context, 128K max output, text and image input, adaptive thinking always on, default effort medium). https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/whats-new-opus-5-5: thinking {type: disabled} or {type: enabled, budget_tokens} returns HTTP 400 (send {type: adaptive}); forced tool_choice any/tool returns HTTP 400 (none is sent); effort low..max including xhigh, and at xhigh/max the model thinks more per turn than earlier models (max_tokens 64000 leaves room); structured outputs supported; refusals arrive as HTTP 200 with stop_reason refusal and stop_details (category may be reasoning_extraction). Request shape checked against the installed anthropic==1.11.0 Messages.stream signature.
notes: MLLM-02 per 15-CONTEXT.md D-14/D-15/D-20/D-21. effort xhigh is the default highest sensible level; max is reserved as a Phase 16 ablation because the docs warn it can overthink structured-output tasks (research C11). Sampling parameters are not sent: the adapter never sends sampling parameters to Claude models with adaptive thinking and the SDK's Messages.stream has no such parameters, so the shared nominal sampling is logged as requested and omitted, never sent (research C3). Adaptive thinking is always on for this model; display 'summarized' returns readable summaries while all raw thinking tokens are billed and count toward max_tokens (64000 covers thinking plus the JSON answer; research Pitfall 10). A refusal (stop_details.category, e.g. reasoning_extraction) or a max_tokens stop is a failed call held for chunk_len ticks (research C4). api_key_env names the environment variable holding a restricted, workspace-scoped key; never put the key itself in this file. Chunk length, timing, depth and image settings are inherited from mllm_defaults.json. Switched from claude-fable-5-1 to claude-opus-5-5 by user decision 2026-10-02 (15-LIVE-RESULTS.md section 2); effort kept xhigh explicitly (Opus 5.5 default is medium); Fable smoke evidence no longer applies — re-smoke required.
